authors: Brischoux F, Pizzatto L, Shine R
title: Insights into the adaptive significance of vertical pupil shape in snakes
why: Supplementary Table S1 lists pupil shape for 127 snake species in five families including Elapidae; the abstract page names no genus, so the table would show whether Micrurus has a round pupil.
get: journal via library (OUP page academic.oup.com/jeb/article/23/9/1878/7325000; Table S1 is a supplement)

authors: Machovsky-Capuska GE, Huynen L, Lambert D, Raubenheimer D
title: UVS is rare in seabirds
why: Sequences SWS1 opsin of 16 seabird species in 8 families; the Griffith abstract page names only three species, so the paper must be read to see whether Anous or another noddy was sampled and which SWS1 type it has.
get: journal via library (Vision Research 51(12); abstract at research-repository.griffith.edu.au/items/70cf15bf-47fe-52c7-9e1a-7f1fdb8d9851)

authors: Thomas KN, Rich C, Quock R, Streicher J, Gower DJ, Schott RK, Fujita MK, Bell RC
title: Diversity and evolution of amphibian pupil shapes (data set: Amphibian pupil data CSV, 1,293 species)
why: The preprint text names no Rhacophoridae genus, so the species CSV is needed to set pupil_shape for Zhangixalus (formerly Rhacophorus); same file as the Polypedates request.
get: open access: download the CSV from data.nhm.ac.uk/dataset/diversity-and-evolution-of-amphibian-pupil-shapes

authors: Fox GL, Coyle-Thompson CA, Bellinger PF, Cohen RW
title: Phototactic responses to ultraviolet and white light in various species of Collembola, including the eyeless species, Folsomia candida
why: Tests UV and white light responses in several springtail species; if Dicyrtomina or another Symphypleona is among them it would show whether the genus responds to ultraviolet, bearing on spectral_range_nm. Open at PMC2999417 but the PMC page returned a robot check and the journal page an Incapsula block.
get: open access: PMC2999417 (europepmc.org may open it); journal page bioone.org/journals/journal-of-insect-science/volume-7/issue-22

authors: Thomas KN, Rich C, Quock R, Streicher J, Gower DJ, Schott RK, Fujita MK, Bell RC
title: Diversity and evolution of amphibian pupil shapes (data set: Amphibian pupil data CSV, 1,293 species)
why: The preprint text names Dicroglossidae only in a figure key and no Limnonectes, so the species CSV is needed to set pupil_shape for Limnonectes; same file as the Zhangixalus and Polypedates requests.
get: open access: download the CSV from data.nhm.ac.uk/dataset/diversity-and-evolution-of-amphibian-pupil-shapes

authors: Potier S, Mitkus M, Kelber A
title: Visual adaptations of diurnal and nocturnal raptors
journal: Seminars in Cell and Developmental Biology 106:116-126
why: Review of raptor eyes, visual fields, retinal cone density and temporal resolution; its tables may hold figures for Old World vultures, which could set field, binocular overlap or acuity for Gypaetus (the abstract page names no species).
